title: Planner Worker
description: Planner log for splitting the placement file into bounded jobs, shared locks, checkpoints, and retry behavior before build workers start.

messages.text: Loaded workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001/blueprint/placements.jsonl and scaffold_hints.json. Planning output will be written to workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001/plan.
messages.systemLog: planner INFO open placements rows=9274 bbox=(-24,63,-18)..(24,95,21) hints=41

messages.text: Splitting by x-volume is safer than splitting by object label. I am keeping column x=0 locked so the mirrored roof ribs cannot overwrite the center seam.
messages.systemLog: planner DEBUG partition west=x[-24,-1], east=x[1,24], shared=x[0]; lockfile=plan/locks.json

messages.text: Created two region files and six worker queues. Entrance trim stays in a gated queue until both roof checkpoints pass.
messages.systemLog: planner INFO wrote plan/west.json plan/east.json plan/checkpoints.json retry_policy=max2 backoff=750ms

messages.text: west-foreman: builder-01 gets foundation and lower walls, builder-02 gets west roof rows, builder-03 owns movement markers and scaffold cleanup tags.
messages.systemLog: queue INFO publish west jobs=3 write_scope=plan/west.json readonly=shared_axis:x0 server=127.0.0.1:25565

messages.text: east-foreman: mirror confirmed west geometry, stage the entrance supports, and wait for checkpoint roof_rib_alignment before closing the arch.
messages.systemLog: queue INFO publish east jobs=3 mirror=x*-1 delayed=entry_arch.close checkpoints=foundation_alignment,roof_rib_alignment

messages.text: Build workers may start. Stream block diffs to world/*.diff.jsonl and write any temporary blocks with tmp tags so verification can remove them deterministically.
messages.systemLog: planner INFO dispatch build_pool concurrency=6 diff_sink=world/*.diff.jsonl temp_tag_prefix=tmp/

messages.text: Planning stage complete. Returning west/east job files, locks, checkpoints, and retry policy to the run console.
